description_excerpt: NVIDIA is the world leader in accelerated computing. Our innovations in GPU technology, AI, and data center solutions are transforming industries worldwide. Join our engineering group passionate about local product development in Israel to play a meaningful role in bringing powerful hardware products from building to mass production. The Local Product Engineering (LPE) group bridges the gap between hardware build, NPI phase and high-volume manufacturing. We work closely with contract manufacturers (CMs) globally to ensure mechanical readiness, production quality, and manufacturing excellence…
